notes_for_editor: Single source: the tnlandforms.us list (map revised 2016), which gives name, point, elevation and GFC/BLL numbers only. The list prints no unit; its elevations are read as feet (Brasstown at 4735 fits feet only). Checked and absent: the cached NHLR Georgia listing and the cached FFLOS Georgia data have no Upson County entry. The FFLA Georgia page (firelookout.org) was empty in the cache and not re-checked. Search and newspaper-archive attempts returned nothing usable. Next steps: the Georgia Forestry Commission's own records or a county newspaper search.
